data.long_description:
Presenting a beautifully designed 1-bedroom apartment in Binghatti Venus, located in District 13, Jumeirah Village Circle - one of Dubai's most sought-after and high-demand residential communities. The unit features a bright open-plan living and dining area with large windows allowing abundant natural light, a spacious bedroom with built-in wardrobes, a contemporary open kitchen with high-quality cabinetry, and a sleek, modern bathroom. The tower stands out with its distinctive facade and excellent build quality, ensuring long-term value and rental appeal.

Key Features:
- 1 Spacious Bedroom
- Built-in Wardrobes
- Open-Plan Kitchen
- Bright Living & Dining Area
- Covered Parking
- Central AC
- High-Quality Finishes

Building Amenities: 
- Swimming Pool
- Fully Equipped Gymnasium 
- 24/7 Security & CCTV
- High-Speed Elevators
- Children's Play Area

Location Highlights – Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC)
- Located in District 13
- Easy access to Al Khail Road & Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road
- Close to Circle Mall, supermarkets & retail outlets
- Nearby schools and healthcare facilities
- 15–20 minutes to Dubai Marina & Downtown Dubai

Investment Highlights:
- High rental demand in JVC
- Strong ROI potential
- Ideal for investors and end-users
